查询指定父空间下的所有子空间，可选包含父空间自身，满足灵活的空间层级查询需求。

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}

  children={"Request"}
>
</Heading>

  parameters={[{"name":"parentSpaceId","in":"query","description":"父空间 ID。为空时返回所有顶级空间（即没有父空间的空间，属于空间树的根节点）。","required":false,"schema":{"type":"string"}},{"name":"needChildren","in":"query","description":"是否查询父空间下的子空间。若 parentSpaceId 非空且 needChildren 为 false，则不返回子空间（仅在 needParentSpaceSelf 为 true 时可返回父空间自身）。","required":false,"schema":{"type":"boolean","default":true}},{"name":"needParentSpaceSelf","in":"query","description":"是否包含 parentSpaceId 对应的父空间自身。仅当 parentSpaceId 非空时生效。","required":false,"schema":{"type":"boolean","default":false}},{"name":"includeMetadata","in":"query","description":"是否包含空间元数据，默认false。","required":false,"schema":{"type":"boolean","default":false}}]}
